FOOTNOTES

1/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as a Lump Sum by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$557,500 and 4 FTE Positions from the Board for Private Postsecondary Education Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

The spending plan associated with the FY 2026 budget included \$100,000 each year beginning in FY 2026 and ending in FY 2030 for a record digitization project. The FY 2031 Baseline will remove this funding.
